name: Feature request

labels: enhancement

---

## The idea

One or two sentences describing the feature.

## Why

What problem does this solve, or what does it enable that isn't possible today?

## Sketch (optional)

If you have a concrete proposal — a UI mockup, a code outline, a config flag — drop it here.

## Roadmap fit

Does this overlap with anything already in the [README's roadmap](../../README.md#roadmap)? If so, link to that section.

## Scope

How much surface area does this change touch?

- [ ] Self-contained — one module
- [ ] Multiple modules — engine + UI
- [ ] Affects save/JSON schema (would need `SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION` bump and a migration)
- [ ] Affects commentary / rosters content (data-only, no code change)
